name: Sing Investments & Finance Limited
summary: Sing Investments & Finance Limited provides financing and related nominee services to individuals and corporations in Singapore. The company offers fixed and savings deposits, current, GIRO saver, GoVault, and conveyancing accounts. It provides housing, HDB, commercial property, car, share, shipping, land and construction, machinery, and unsecured business loans; SME/ corporate financing, such as commercial property loan, machinery loan, enterprise financing scheme (EFS), shipping loan, land and construction loan, accounts receivables/invoice factoring, block financing, and floor stock financing; and various e-services.
